headline: Profitability rebounds q/q but still trails last year
summary_short: Harley-Davidson posted Q2 FY2026 revenue of $1,230.4M, up 4.9% q/q but down 5.9% y/y, with diluted EPS of $0.75 rebounding sharply from $0.22 q/q while still trailing $0.88 a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue was $1,230.4M, +4.9% q/q, -5.9% y/y. Gross margin rose to 34.2% from 32.3% q/q but compressed from 42.6% y/y. Operating margin improved to 6.2% from 2.0% q/q, versus 8.6% y/y. Diluted EPS of $0.75 rebounded from $0.22 q/q but fell from $0.88 y/y. Cash rose to $1,895.8M, +5.0% q/q, +19.4% y/y. Long-term debt fell 74.3% y/y.
